comment: Shared golden fixture for the knowledge-digest two-sided contract: orchestrator/knowledge-digest.js (JS) and build_knowledge_digest() in agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py (Python) must both reproduce expectedMarkdown byte-for-byte. Regenerate ONLY when deliberately changing the digest format — and change both implementations in the same commit.

cases.name: default-budget
cases.expectedMarkdown:
# Team Knowledge Digest

> GENERATED — do not edit. Auto-built from the team knowledge base (team `demo-team`);
> regenerated before every run and whenever the team's knowledge changes.
> Contribute with `knowledge add fact|entity|convention "<one-line statement>"`;
> everything beyond this digest is searchable with `knowledge search "<topic>"`.
>
> Generated: 2026-07-13T09:00:00Z · Included: 4 of 4 entries (conventions 1/1, facts 2/2, entities 1/1) · ~47 of 3000 tokens

## Conventions — how we do things here

- Branch from origin/main (2026-07-01, 3× confirmed)

## Validated lessons — independently learned by several agents

- fact: CI runs on Node 22 (2×, 2026-07-02)

## Recent lessons

- entity: github-poller.js polls every 30s (2026-07-03)
- fact: Old lesson (2026-06-01)
